author: JSCA
text_post: I do not know whether it is opening or peacocking, but it is almost guaranteed to work. All you do is wear a t-shirt with a metal band on. Because open metal fans are very rare, when a girl metal fan will see it and suddenly compliment you on a your shirt, or say, "I love them" Both sexes will approach you but I am always sure it will help. Even if it will not make the girl approach you, when you are talking, quite often a friend of your target, or even your target will comment on your shirt, whether its saying, "I love them." or "My ex loved them" it will always help. Some good bands to wear are: Nirvana Iron Maiden Metallica Lamb of God Black Sabbath Trivium Bullet For My valentine(In my experience, girls will comment without even knowing it is a band) Linkin Park Please do not hesitate to add more bands that have worked for you.
